title.narrative: Forests for Livelihood Improvement in the Central Highlands (Sector Loan)

description.narrative: The Project objectives and activities include: (i) formulating technically sound and socially relevant SFM plans for over 3 million ha of natural forests and plantations on bare land. SFM plan preparation will include (a) delineating forest conservation and use zones, (b) rationalizing Government's and stakeholders' roles and responsibilities, and enabling effective participation of the local communities and the private sector in SFM, and (c) providing investments for improving the condition and productivity of household, community, and state managed forests; (ii) providing wage generating and livelihood improvement investments, especially for forest-dependent ethnic minorities; (iii) supporting stakeholder technical and operational capacity building for SFM; and (iv) providing project implementation support.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 30,000 ha of high yielding plantations established, and 99,000 ha of natural forests protected, under non-state sector forestry, improving livelihoods of over 80,000 hh. Indicator: Important forested watershed areas under protection regime with village support Progress/Status: The total area of planted protective forest is 1,118 ha, equivalent to 16% of the target. 59,348 ha of natural forest were contracted with 2,941 households for protection. Data Source: Provinicial and district forest inventories Actual value:

Output: 30,000 ha of high yielding plantations established, and 99,000 ha of natural forests protected, under non-state sector forestry, improving livelihoods of over 80,000 hh. Indicator: Increased cash incomes in project communes Progress/Status: The average income per person in 1 month by revenue in the project area has increased 5.8 times from 522,400 in 2006 to 3,041 million Dong in 2015. Data Source: Provinicial and district forest inventories Baseline year: 2006 Baseline year: 2006 Target year: 2014

Output: 30,000 ha of high yielding plantations established, and 99,000 ha of natural forests protected, under non-state sector forestry, improving livelihoods of over 80,000 hh. Indicator: Provincial forestry statistics and sale data Progress/Status: Up to 30/10/2015: The total area of production forests planted by households is 13, 869 ha, reaching 79% of the project target. The total planted area is 11,305 hectares (SFE 8,509 ha, 258% above target; SMEs planted 2,796 ha, 53% of target); Total area home gardens is 2,860 ha, 71% of target The total agroforestry area is 9,458 ha, achieving 137% of target. Data Source: Provinicial and district forest inventories Baseline year: 2006 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2006 Baseline value: N Target year: 2014 Target value: Y

Output: Enhanced business models and capacity of six provincial forestry departments, at least 3 SFEs, 60 SMEs and 75 community groups Indicator: DARD forest administration and revenue statistics Progress/Status: To be updated upon receipt of draft PCR. Data Source: Provincial business and enterprise statistics Baseline year: 2006 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2006 Baseline value: N Target year: 2014 Target value: Y

Output: Enhanced business models and capacity of six provincial forestry departments, at least 3 SFEs, 60 SMEs and 75 community groups Indicator: SFE, SME, and community forestry business success and failure rate Progress/Status: The project supports in preparing business plan for 3 forestry companies and 18 SMEs in 6 provinces. At the present time, success and failure in business enterprises supported by the project is yet to be evaluated. Data Source: Provincial business and enterprise statistics Baseline year: 2006 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2006 Baseline value: N Target year: 2014 Target value: Y

Output: Forest planning and management decision-support systems, and capacity of project stakeholders and forestry education and training institutions enhanced at provincial, district and commune levels in 6 provinces and 60 communes. Indicator: Employment success rate of Central Highlands forestry training institutions graduates Progress/Status: Will be updated upon receipt of draft PCR.

Output: Forest planning and management decision-support systems, and capacity of project stakeholders and forestry education and training institutions enhanced at provincial, district and commune levels in 6 provinces and 60 communes. Indicator: Provincial forestry enterprise statistics Progress/Status: The project supported 55 plantation enterprises in 6 provinces, including 30 forestry companies and 25 SMEs. The total plantation area of businesses amounted to 11,305 ha (8,509 ha owned by forestry companies; 2,860 ha by SMEs). This is a general indicator. Insufficient evidence to link the project decision support system to enhanced forestry planning and capacity building for project stakeholders.

Output: Six performance-enhancing, sustainable forest management plans covering over 3 million ha and timber stocks worth $4.4 billion Indicator: Approved commune forest management plans Progress/Status: The communal Forest Management Plan used Vietnamese funding to implement the plans in 2014 -2015. Data Source: Provincial and istrict forest inventories Baseline year: 2006 Baseline value: n Baseline year: 2006 Baseline value: n Target year: 2014 Target value: y

Output: Six performance-enhancing, sustainable forest management plans covering over 3 million ha and timber stocks worth $4.4 billion Indicator: Approved provincial forest management plans (FMP) Progress/Status: Five out of the 6 provinces plans to protect and develop forests, were approved by 2020. Gia Lai province approved its plan in 2014 using national funding sources. Data Source: Provincial and istrict forest inventories Baseline year: 2006 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2006 Baseline value: N Target year: 2014 Target value: Y
